verdict.rationale: SerpApi is a search API, so finding pages similar to a given URL is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack documents no similar-pages or related-URL capability. The docs only say standard Google operators (`inurl:`, `site:`, `intitle:`) can be passed through, and none of them finds pages similar to a URL. Inferring a similarity feature from that general passthrough would rely on outside knowledge.
